claims: Monitor serum potassium closely and treat hyperkalemia, given potassium 6.2 mEq/L and active potassium chloride infusion.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and monitor airway pressures and oxygenation.
Maintain phenylephrine infusion and monitor hemodynamics given borderline blood pressures (MAP ~60 mmHg).
Continue insulin infusion and monitor blood glucose.
Assess and manage pain, with PRN analgesics as ordered, given reported worst pain 10.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit for anemia and consider transfusion if clinically indicated.
Continue temporary pacemaker with monitoring of settings and rhythm.
Monitor coagulation parameters (INR, PTT, fibrinogen) given elevated INR and low fibrinogen.
Perform regular neurologic assessments including sedation scale and delirium screening.
Implement aspiration precautions and oral care given intubation and subglottic suctioning.
